game_title: Exponent Engine – Cinder Cone Camp Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round, a new ore chunks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
